book.label: exp_G_regime_mr
book.why: G: trend→A momentum; chop→fade large moves only, skip small, size cap 100 (crypto primary this campaign; stock shadow)

exp_A_short.why: A: trade on short-horizon move only (~30s–1m) — stock primary this campaign; crypto shadow / baseline compare

exp_B_short_med.why: B: short + 5m + 10m move buckets must agree (reduce chase)

exp_C_multi.why: C: short+5m+10m+1h agree; block new risk if 1d trend opposite

exp_D_imbalance.why: D: same as A entry, but trade_imbalance must agree (buy>ImbMin, sell<-ImbMin; missing/0 fails)

exp_E_exit_overlay.why: E: same as A entry + TP/time/trailing auto-exit overlay on this book only

exp_F_inv_skew.why: F: same as A + inventory skew (block/boost by net long/short & cash; soft noul bump when long-heavy)

exp_H_markout_veto.why: H: same as A + veto symbol if recent avg adverse markout worse than -8 bps
